name: 近身搏击
description: 选择敌人（1），造成2次0.5倍物理伤害，每次实际造成伤害回复1点生命。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 1, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var damage = Math.floor(source.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); var totalDamage = 0; var totalHeal = 0; for (var hit = 0; hit < 2; hit++) { if (source.currentHp <= 0 || !battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === source.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; }) || target.currentHp <= 0 || !battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === target.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; })) break; var result = dealDamage(source, target, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); var dealt = result && Number(result.damage || 0); if (dealt > 0) { totalDamage += dealt; if (source.currentHp > 0 && battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === source.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; })) { var recovery = healDamage(source, source, 1, battle, context.skill.id); totalHeal += recovery && Number(recovery.heal || 0); } } } return { success: true, message: source.name + '对' + target.name + '造成' + totalDamage + '点伤害' + (totalHeal > 0 ? '并回复' + totalHeal + '点生命' : '') }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece) { var damagePerHit = Math.floor(piece.attack * 0.5); return { description: '对1格内敌人造成2次0.5倍物理伤害，每次实际造成伤害回复1点生命。', expectedValues: { damage: damagePerHit * 2, damagePerHit: damagePerHit, hits: 2, healing: 2, healingPerHit: 1 } }; }
